mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END AS is_exist_flag FROM tb_att_update_req_n WHERE 1 = 1 AND employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND time_and_attendance_date = trunc(to_date(#{actualDate}, 'dd/mm/yyyy')) AND subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_att_update_req_n (request_no ,request_seq_no ,request_date ,subsidiary_code ,time_and_attendance_date ,employee_no ,shift_type_code ,time_and_attendance_code ,work_hours ,work_start_time ,night_shift_flag ,evening_meal_flag ,overtime_sum_hours ,weekday_overtime_hours ,holiday_overtime_hours ,public_holiday_overtime_hours ,weekday_night_overtime_hours ,weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours ,holiday_night_overtime_hours ,public_holiday_night_ot_hours ,normal_night_overtime_hours ,tardy_hours ,early_leave_hours ,going_out_hours ,special_bonus_hours ,helpcall_support_hours ,data_old_new_type_code ,update_request_reason_desc ,approval_request_id ,request_code ,progress_status_code ,time_attend_detail_code ,creation_user_id ,creation_date ,last_update_user_id ,last_update_date) SELECT #{requestNo} ,sq_tb_att_update_req_id.nextval ,SYSDATE ,subsidiary_code ,time_and_attendance_date ,employee_no ,shift_type_code ,time_and_attendance_code ,work_hours ,work_start_time ,night_shift_flag ,evening_meal_flag ,overtime_sum_hours ,weekday_overtime_hours ,holiday_overtime_hours ,public_holiday_overtime_hours ,weekday_night_overtime_hours ,weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours ,holiday_night_overtime_hours ,public_holiday_night_ot_hours ,normal_night_overtime_hours ,tardy_hours ,early_leave_hours ,going_out_hours ,special_bonus_hours ,helpcall_support_hours ,'OLD' ,NULL ,#{requestMasterId} ,#{requestCode} ,'20' ,time_attend_detail_code ,creation_user_id ,creation_date ,last_update_user_id ,last_update_date FROM tb_att_result_n WHERE 1 = 1 AND time_and_attendance_date = TRUNC(to_date(#{actualDate}, 'dd/mm/yyyy')) AND employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode}
mapper.select: SELECT AA.* ,CASE WHEN to_date(AA.actual_date || ' ' || AA.actual_in_time, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') >= to_date(AA.actual_date || ' ' || AA.actual_start_tm, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') + INTERVAL '-5' MINUTE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS illegal_in_time_flag ,CASE WHEN AA.actual_shift_code LIKE '1%' THEN ( CASE WHEN to_date(AA.actual_date || ' ' || AA.actual_start_tm, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') < to_date(AA.actual_date || ' 17:00', 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AND to_date(AA.actual_date || ' ' || AA.actual_start_tm, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') >= to_date(AA.actual_date || ' 08:00', 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') THEN ( CASE WHEN to_date(AA.actual_date || ' ' || AA.actual_out_time, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') <= to_date(AA.actual_date || ' ' || AA.actual_start_tm, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') + INTERVAL '9' HOUR THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ) -- 1부제 Day ELSE ( CASE WHEN to_date(AA.actual_date || ' ' || AA.actual_out_time, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') + INTERVAL '24' HOUR <= to_date(AA.actual_date || ' ' || AA.actual_start_tm, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') + INTERVAL '9' HOUR THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ) -- 1부제 Night END ) ELSE ( CASE WHEN to_date(AA.actual_date || ' ' || AA.actual_start_tm, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') < to_date(AA.actual_date || ' 20:00', 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AND to_date(AA.actual_date || ' ' || AA.actual_start_tm, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') >= to_date(AA.actual_date || ' 08:00', 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') THEN ( CASE WHEN to_date(AA.actual_date || ' ' || AA.actual_out_time, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') <= to_date(AA.actual_date || ' ' || AA.actual_start_tm, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') + INTERVAL '12' HOUR THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ) -- 2부제 Day ELSE ( CASE WHEN to_date(AA.actual_date || ' ' || AA.actual_out_time, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') + INTERVAL '24' HOUR <= to_date(AA.actual_date || ' ' || AA.actual_start_tm, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') + INTERVAL '12' HOUR THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ) -- 2부제 Night END ) END AS illegal_out_time_flag FROM ( SELECT em.employee_number AS employee_no ,em.full_name_local AS employee_name ,em.grade_title AS employee_grade ,aur.data_old_new_type_code AS data_old_new_type ,aur.time_and_attendance_date AS actual_date ,aur.shift_type_code AS actual_shift_code ,ac.time_and_attendance_type_code AS actual_attendance_type ,aur.time_and_attendance_code AS actual_attendance_detail ,aur.time_attend_detail_code AS actual_attend_detail_reason ,aur.night_shift_flag AS actual_day_night ,nvl(aur.evening_meal_flag, 'N') AS actual_dinner_chk ,aur.work_start_time AS actual_start_tm ,to_char(lgvatt_common_pkg.get_idcard_inout_time(#{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} ,em.employee_number ,aur.time_and_attendance_date ,'IN'), 'HH24:MI') AS actual_in_time ,to_char(lgvatt_common_pkg.get_idcard_inout_time(#{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} ,em.employee_number ,aur.time_and_attendance_date ,'OUT'), 'HH24:MI') AS actual_out_time ,nvl(aur.overtime_sum_hours, 0) AS actual_o_t ,aur.weekday_overtime_hours AS weekday ,aur.holiday_overtime_hours AS weekday_holiday ,aur.public_holiday_overtime_hours AS public_holiday ,aur.weekday_night_overtime_hours AS at_night_weekday ,aur.weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours AS at_night_weekday_after_o_t ,aur.holiday_night_overtime_hours AS at_night_weekday_holiday ,aur.public_holiday_night_ot_hours AS at_night_public_holiday ,aur.normal_night_overtime_hours AS night_normal ,aur.tardy_hours AS deduction_lateness ,aur.early_leave_hours AS deduction_leaving_early ,aur.going_out_hours AS deduction_going_out ,aur.special_bonus_hours AS special_bonus ,aur.helpcall_support_hours AS help_call ,ac.update_enable_flag AS actual_update_enable ,aur.update_request_reason_desc AS modification_reason FROM tb_att_update_req_n aur ,emp_master em ,tb_att_code_c ac WHERE 1 = 1 AND aur.employee_no = em.employee_number AND aur.time_and_attendance_code = ac.time_and_attendance_code AND aur.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} -- AND em.assignment_category = 'LGD_LW' AND aur.approval_request_id = #{requestMasterId} AND aur.request_code = #{requestCode} AND em.flsa_yn = 'N' AND em.fse_yn = 'N' ) AA ORDER BY AA.employee_no, AA.data_old_new_type DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN SYSDATE < lgvatt_common_pkg.get_att_close_time(#{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} ,#{actionType} ,trunc(to_date(#{attDate}, 'dd/mm/yyyy'))) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS submit_flag FROM dual

SELECT CASE WHEN trunc(to_date(#{attDate}, 'dd/mm/yyyy')) = lgvatt_common_pkg.get_att_close_time(#{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} ,#{actionType} ,trunc(to_date(#{attDate}, 'dd/mm/yyyy'))) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS modify_flag FROM dual
